mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tw_batch_task WHERE created_by_id = #{userId} AND finished_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tw_batch_task t WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tw_point_change_log p WHERE p.source_type = 'batch_task' AND p.source_id = t.task_no AND p.change_type = 'refund' )
AND 1 = 0
AND t.created_by_username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operatorKeyword}, '%')
AND t.template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{templateName}, '%')
AND t.task_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskNo}, '%')
AND t.created_at >= #{startTime}
AND t.created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT DISTINCT t.created_by_username FROM tw_batch_task t WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_by_username IS NOT NULL AND t.created_by_username != '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tw_point_change_log p WHERE p.source_type = 'batch_task' AND p.source_id = t.task_no AND p.change_type = 'refund' )
AND t.created_by_username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.created_by_username
